coverage_override.reason: The continuous original-ATK calculation and three separately activatable HOPT effects account for all mechanics; the shared limit sentence is attached to the latter three.

effects.printed_clause: This card's original ATK becomes 250 times the number of "Bau" cards you control.
effects.lua_implementation: A single-range EFFECT_SET_BASE_ATTACK now counts only face-up cards on this player's field that publicly satisfy the Bau setcode, multiplying that count by 250.

official_references.matched_structure: Official continuous archetype-card field counts combine Card.IsFaceup and Card.IsSetCard before deriving a persistent effect value.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: face-down cards do not publicly possess an archetype for this continuous calculation. The old bare Card.IsSetCard count could include hidden Bau cards.

effects.printed_clause: If you control "Bauy World": You can Special Summon this card from your banishment.
effects.lua_implementation: A banished-zone Ignition Effect checks for face-up Bauy World and summon legality, then Special Summons this card under the first HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official conditioned self-Special Summons from a non-hand location check field state, available zone, and summon legality.

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Bau" you control; equip this card to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 2500 ATK, from your face-up field or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main-Phase Quick Effect from the Monster Zone/GY targets a controlled Bau, equips this card if both remain legal, applies a bound equip limit, and grants 2500 ATK under a distinct HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official monster-to-Equip-Spell Quick Effects target an eligible monster, call Duel.Equip, register EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT, and grant ATK.

effects.printed_clause: If a monster this card is equipped to destroys a monster by battle: You can add 1 monster from your banishment to your hand, then, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 monster.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed equipped-card battle-destroying trigger recovers one face-up banished monster, then optionally performs an immediate legal Normal Summon under its own HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official immediate Normal Summon effects select a currently summonable monster and resolve with Duel.Summon.
